title: A Marketplace sale's copy in the business's books: written whole or not at all, the tenant put back after each write, the portal's own connection refused, and a failed copy tried again daily
why: Gate 5 (decisions/0181 §1, money records; the IT Manager's (11) ticket from the session manager, 2026-11-27). MarketCheckout::writeOrder writes the sale into the business's walled data (decisions/0110) through BusinessData::open, which switched the whole request to that business (Scope::enterBusiness) and never switched back. On live, the daily tick's reconcile (MarketCheckout.php:756) marks several card orders paid in one request, and from the second on Scope.php:19 threw 'already working for a business': the business never got that order or its payment in Quotes & invoices. Placing a direct-pay order ran writeOrder outside any try (:391), so a failed copy reached the buyer as an error with no payment instructions though the order was placed. And a copy that failed after its first line was left half-written (a draft with part of the total, never linked). Now: BusinessData::scoped opens the business on its own connection, runs the write and, in a finally, sets @tv_tenant to NULL and leaves (Scope::leave, refused for any connection but the one that entered); a request already inside a business (the portal) is refused before anything is written. writeOrder writes the copy in one transaction (its lines, total and card payment, or nothing), reuses a copy written but never linked, and never records the same card payment twice. place and markPaid catch a failed copy; the business is told where the order is meanwhile (E-commerce setup → Marketplace orders), that it's added again at the next daily Marketplace check, and to write to support@traversence.com if no message follows; the raw error goes only to the server's log. The daily tick tries each missing copy again before expiring holds, and tells the business when it's in Quotes & invoices. Data: the first daily check after this goes live also writes the copies live's orders are missing because of the old fault (awaiting or paid, no copy), each with its card payment once; nothing else is changed (the same rows, triggers and views, BusinessData.php:110-112). Not in this release (found by the CFO's review, its own ticket): MarketSquare::import and sync (MarketSquare.php:120, :160) also open a business and never leave.

changes.what: Card orders marked paid together each reach their business's Quotes & invoices; a copy is written whole or not at all
A copy that can't be written: the business is told where the order is meanwhile and that it's added again daily, then told when it's there; the buyer of a direct-pay order still gets how to pay

checks.write-order: tools/market-tests/write-order.php 15 on MariaDB with the listings realm BusinessData::ensure builds (its triggers and views): two businesses in one request both written, each in its own; owner 0 and no business connection after; @tv_tenant NULL on the connection after and a write on it refused; a throw midway comes back with the scope at 0 and the next business still written; a portal request refused with why, nothing written, its scope and tenant untouched; Scope::leave refuses another connection. On the live code: fails (the second write throws).
checks.write-order-place: tools/market-tests/write-order-place.php 12 on MariaDB, MarketCheckout's place() as built with stand-ins for the outside libraries it passes through: a direct-pay order placed with its invoice and the usual words; a failed copy never the buyer's error, the buyer still told how to pay, the business told why, a note on the order, nothing half-written, the scope at 0; the next business's order in the same request written. On the live code: 6 fail.

data_reason: The daily check writes, in each business's own books, the Marketplace order copies its live orders are missing (status awaiting or paid with no biz_quote_id): one invoice per order, with its card payment once; no row is changed or deleted.
